definitions.explanation: A product manufactured in large quantities using standardized processes, as opposed to handmade or custom-made items.

examples.japanese: これは{量産品|りょうさんひん}ではなく{手作|てづく}りだ。
{量産品|りょうさんひん}なので{価格|かかく}が{安|やす}い。
examples.english: It's cheap because it's a mass-produced item.

examples.japanese: {伝統|でんとう}{工芸品|こうげいひん}は{量産品|りょうさんひん}にはない{温|あたた}かみと{個性|こせい}があるが、その{分|ぶん}{値段|ねだん}も{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Traditional crafts have a warmth and individuality that mass-produced items lack, but they are also more expensive.

notes:
A compound of {量産|りょうさん} (mass production) and {品|ひん} (product, item). Often used in contrast with {手作|てづく}り (handmade), {一点物|いってんもの} (one-of-a-kind item), or {特注品|とくちゅうひん} (custom-made item).

The word can carry a slightly negative nuance, implying lack of individuality or lower quality compared to artisanal products. In discussions of traditional crafts, the distinction between {量産品|りょうさんひん} and {手作|てづく}りの{品|しな} is culturally significant in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {量産品|りょうさんひん}と{手作|てづく}り: mass-produced vs. handmade
- {安|やす}い{量産品|りょうさんひん}: cheap mass-produced goods
- {量産品|りょうさんひん}レベル: mass-production level

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {既製品|きせいひん}: ready-made product — emphasizes being pre-made rather than custom
- {大量生産品|たいりょうせいさんひん}: mass-produced product — longer synonym with the same meaning
- {一点物|いってんもの}: one-of-a-kind item — the opposite, a unique handcrafted piece
